howto.what: 生成一个社区/配对数据仪表板，包含左侧导航、实时信号、核心指标等，并展示30天配对柱状图与趋势。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建配对数据墙，或需要展示配对相关数据（信号、KPI、趋势）时触发。

say.text: 给我做一个配对数据墙，包含实时信号和30天配对柱状图。
say.note: 会生成一个社区配对数据仪表板。

say.text: 设计一个社区配对仪表板，突出配对率和趋势。
say.note: 仪表板会包含KPI和趋势模块。

howto.what_en: Generate a community/dating dashboard with left rail navigation, a live signal ticker, headline KPIs, and a 30-day mutual matches bar chart with a match-rate trend block, using editorial typography and restrained accent colors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create a matching data wall or community dashboard, or needs to display matching-related data such as signals, KPIs, trends.

say_en.text: Create a matching data wall with a live ticker and a 30-day match bar chart.
Design a community matching dashboard highlighting match rate and trend.
say_en.note: The dashboard will include KPIs and trend sections.
